note: Actual participation, honestly reported. Six roles were requested: coordinator, adversary/methodology reviewer, two independent mechanism designers, closest-prior-work reviewer and mathematical/implementation verifier. All six were filled by separate agents except the coordinator, which was the main session. One additional read-only helper compiled the closed-lane facts as a coordinator aid. Durations are from the agents' completion notices (wall-clock, LLM time, not local CPU). Local numerical work by agents ran through the campaign queue and is in RESOURCE_INVENTORY.json.

agents.work: worktree, ledger and guard; problem specification; evidence pack; selection criteria; decision log; reveal protocol; selection; prototype (finite laws, continuous laws, demonstrations); pilot code and rehearsal; curation of all top-level deliverables; custody; publication

agents.role: closed-lane evidence helper (coordinator aid, not one of the six roles)

phases.phase: 1: papers, code tracing, access table, motivation, manuscript patch
1: literature base (47 PDFs read in full text) and manuscript citation fidelity
2: comparison of both proposals with closest methods
1: assessment of both proposals with separate code
2: independent recomputation of the MMP prototype and a registered post-hoc probe (P7)
phases.status: done; roles/math_verifier/PROTOTYPE_VERIFICATION.md (+ .json); durations derived from the cumulative completion notice (2893 s total, 91 tool uses)

independence: Designers were launched in parallel with the identical brief (roles/coordinator/DESIGNER_BRIEF.md); launch messages differed by one sentence (disclosed in DECISION_LOG.md). Each designer reported never opening the other's directory; both proposals were hashed and logged before any reveal. The verifier wrote separate code and did not import the coordinator's prototype modules.
